$comment: The carrier handoff, declared once. Subject: WHICH payload we ship (paths, markers, entry points, version tuple). NOT the carrier's own integration state (member-seams.mjs) and NOT vendored byte integrity (dependency-pins.json) — three subjects, three files. The bundler derives its merge roots from bindPaths; the carrier's payload whitelist should mirror this list rather than keep its own.

entrypoints.$comment: npm script names are public API: the carrier's release.yml member job defaults MEMBER_BUNDLE_SCRIPT=bundle:vcclaw and MEMBER_INTEGRATE_SCRIPT=integrate:vcclaw. Renaming either without updating those vars fails the member job on script-not-found.

paths.$comment: Repo-side paths are private to this repo: the carrier only ever sees the bundle OUTPUT directory.

overlay.$comment: Electron-main code we own. It imports nothing from electron — host objects (app, session, shell, safeStorage) and the capture callback are injected — so it compiles and tests IN THIS REPO (typecheck:overlay, test:overlay). That is the carrier owner's required alternative to moving it into the carrier.
inRepo: release/overlay/vizshare: api.ts, broker.ts, oidc.ts, index.ts (+2 test files, 5 tests)
inCarrier: host wiring that constructs the Electron objects and calls startVizShare
notCompiledHere: release/overlay/defaultProject.ts: the v1 rollback seeder imports carrier types (src/types/api) and is copied only when CARRIER === 'v1'

versionTuple.$comment: Shared BY REFERENCE with the carrier's pin file, never merged into it: these two ids must not disagree.
